note: Light-weight serif display on near-black, one monochrome 3D object lit from the side, two quiet CTAs. Editorial-on-dark done right.
Hero where a hairline diagram (4 labelled stages converging) is the art. Mono labels in pills on 1px rules.
Giant hairline-outline wordmark bleeding off the bottom; single CTA with light-streak corners. Type as texture, near-zero chrome.
Radial point field with hairline spokes behind a split, gradient-to-grey headline. Mono uppercase nav with wide tracking. Close to an embedding-space visual.
Studio intro: chromatic-split wordmark over a wireframe globe, 'enter without audio' micro-link, (c) year in corner. Warm charcoal, not pure black.
Work as a dense 3-column index (project / director / location) in small caps over a desaturated hovered still. Local time in the header. Archive-as-table.
Project list as stacked display-size titles with tiny mono year superscripts. Tight leading, no thumbnails until hover. (Light; invert for dark.)
Work tiles numbered 01/02 with one big metric per tile (94 avg run score, 474 runs) and mono meta line. Numbers-as-proof on case cards.
Infinite drag/scroll canvas of work tiles on black, zoom 1X/2X control, 'Drag or Scroll to Explore' mono hint. Good 3D/immersive-variant reference.
Sticky left caption (title in two greys, body at bottom) while case media scrolls on the right. Local time UTC offset top-right.
Numbered work rows (Nº 01) separated by dotted rules; filmstrip thumbs, hero still, serif+sans title pair and a short paragraph.
Mono display headline + a glowing gradient progress rail; steps 1-3 lit, 4-5 dimmed. Scroll position shown as literal progress through a process.
Pixel-cell scatter that converges into a line then fans out (explore -> refine -> scale). A data-shaped narrative; maps directly to optimization / ES finetuning. (Light; invert.)
Scroll rotates a radial dial of numbered steps; active step sharp, neighbours rotate away and fade. Serif labels on black.
Vertical hairline stepper: square nodes, active item expands with body copy, inactive items grey. Good for timeline / experience.
Blueprint-grid 'how it works' with STEP 01/02/03 mono labels and small wireframe diagrams per step, crop marks on the grid.
Three proof cards: mono eyebrow, one claim, then a tiny purpose-built chart each (dot-grid where each dot = 1%, before/after bar, growth bars). Legend lines in mono.
Single sentence over an animated field of mono digits and pills. Data as texture that can animate state-to-state as you scroll.
Italic serif + roman headline, then a scrubbable line with a 'today' cursor, event pins on the curve and mono axis labels.
Dark hero with dotted connector lines from sources into a product frame on a faint grid. Hairline 'wiring' that could carry a pipeline diagram.
Footer as a lit 3D scene: glowing mark casting light onto water. Mono small-caps meta row (A: San Francisco / E: contact@) on 1px column rules.
Footer card with a clipped hairline-outline wordmark between two rules; warm-dark brown tint rather than neutral black.
Footer where links are set in large serif (Overview, LinkedIn) under tiny sans labels. One illustration, nothing else.
Quiet footer with a live 'All systems operational' pill; top edge fades from a soft light bloom. Status pill idea -> 'currently: interning at Amazon Robotics'.
Cmd-K palette: context chip, input, rows with kbd shortcut badges on the right, 2px active-row indicator. Model for a portfolio Cmd-K.
Centered pill nav: Menu / theme toggle / live scroll '0%' readout. Radial orbit of items around a drop target. (Light; the pill works dark.)
Scanline/dither shader on a 3D ribbon in one accent (mint) over warm charcoal; light serif headline. Inset frame with notched corner for nav.
Full-screen menu: [Product] bracket labels, numbered 01-08 rows on hairlines, row hover fills; image panel on the left.
Case study beat: full-bleed hero image, then three big light-weight metrics (+275% / 15 h / 4.5/5) with one-line captions, then 'Challenge' at a narrow measure. (Light; the structure is the point.)
Write-up header: mono 'Written by / Published on' byline pair, 2px rule, title, ~65ch body. Share icons as square outline buttons.
Row of large-radius macro-photo tiles, each with a glass label pill + arrow. Square mono eyebrow. Template for 'systems' tiles (GPU retrieval, satellite firmware).
Live demo pane beside the exact code that drives it (layoutId + AnimatePresence). The demo-next-to-source pattern for research write-ups.
Story rows where the year is mid-roll (odometer digits sliding) as each row enters. Hairline row dividers, photo + caption pairs.
Sticky left year index (2014 / 2019 / 2020 / Today) that lights the active year while content scrolls on the right.
Year range pinned to top corners (2006 / 2024), a drawn line crossing the layout, '(04) Chapters' table with date ranges, floating 'Scroll, this is a website!!' pill. Witty, personal. (Light.)
Single 644px column, one Inter-like sans at 16/26.4, two inks only (#000 names, #63635E descriptions). Section labels are the same size as body; hierarchy comes from colour and spacing.

Article with live demos inline: Dynamic Island morph buttons (Idle/Ring/Timer) and a spring visualiser with stiffness/damping/mass sliders + Copy. Easing set includes cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) and (0.23,1,0.32,1).

Horizontal card rail; a staggered-indent display paragraph (75px) is the bio; yellow disc with crosshair cursor; tick-mark scrubber at top as position indicator; mix-blend-mode: difference. cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1).
Dark essay (#161616, text #EDEDED at 16/28, 672px measure) with a quiet sticky ToC on the left; figures on light cards; italic serif for single emphasised words.

#1A1A1A, 640px column, Sohne/Inter body + Newsreader italic for the one-line tagline. Three-column Building/Projects/Writing index with ↗ for external. Full --ease-* token set (in/out quad..expo) defined as CSS vars.

Dark night-sky hero with 3D mascot and rainbow arc; small-caps pink eyebrows; Wotfard + Cartograph mono. Spring easings shipped as CSS linear() with durations (833ms, 1.167s) and view-transition-name on the search modal.
Long-form tutorial: sticky ToC with active-section highlight, callout with hand-drawn bracket, like-counter heart (353,468), sandbox widgets. Body 18/27 at ~686px.

One screen: bio paragraphs, a year-grouped Writing table on hairlines with dd/mm dates right-aligned, and a footer 'local time in city' line. Named motion tokens: snappy 220ms cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.1), smooth 300ms (.19,1,.22,1), swift 800ms.

Black with fading grid in one corner; DM Serif display headline, mono uppercase role line, pink inline links, hand-drawn signature, and a live 'now' stack (location, weather+time, playing, listening) in dot-matrix mono.
#161615 warm black, 14/21 Inter, secondary ink #A1A09A; project cards are dark tiles with a single rendered app icon centered. Extremely small type used confidently.
Fraunces throughout (30px heading, 18/28 body) with Geist Mono accents; bold underlined links act as the index. Plain, warm, editorial. (Light site.)
Pure black, bio at 24/32 in white-70%, writing list at the same size in white. Two inks, one size step, no chrome besides a hamburger.

Hero IS the figure: a loss landscape with draggable start point and two sliders (step-size α, momentum β) that re-run the optimiser live. Byline grid (author / date / citation) under it. Title 56px serif, -1.12px tracking.
Left sticky ToC with nested sections; feature figures show token-level activation highlighting (orange intensity per token) across languages and images. 17/28.8 body at 704px.
IBM Plex Sans 19.2/30.7 on #F8F8F8 at 704px; colour-coded part names in prose match colours in the figure; 'globally pause' link for all animations; each figure has its own pause button.
Dark mode: Source Serif 4 justified + hyphenated, indented paragraphs, dotted-underline link-previews with ↓ markers; strict monochrome.
Computer Modern body 18/27, margin comment bubbles as numbered footnote markers, hand-drawn-feeling diagrams with one highlight colour tracking the concept (the blue h_t).
Zero design: date, blue title link, one-sentence description. Proof that the writing carries it; the bar for 'minimal' is set by content quality.
Dark long-form (#1D1E20, text #C4C4C5 at 16/25.6, 720px): nested bullets and a boxed architecture diagram on white. Shows the cost of un-themed light figures on dark.
Squarespace blog grid: centered bold serif titles in three columns. Included as a counterexample: template layout, low contrast between items, no signal of the research itself.

#191919 grid of visual essays: #223-style issue numbers in outlined pills, month/year right-aligned, each card is a real chart thumbnail on a saturated colour field. Gooper SemiCondensed + Atlas Typewriter.
At 1920px footnotes become numbered sidenotes in the right margin, boxed, aligned to their reference; small-caps page title top-left; ToC left. The sidenote system to borrow for write-ups.
Interactive CS explainers index: condensed serif titles, line-drawn icon per post, dashed crop-mark frame around the featured course, fixed left column with name and blurb. (Light.)

oklch dark (L 0.147, hue 262) with tinted greys; floating pill 'current article' header with progress; code blocks with highlighted line bar; section headings with a trailing hairline. Easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.85,0.32,1.2).
#08090A, Inter Variable 64/64 at weight 510 with -1.4px tracking, secondary #8A8F98; product frame with faint 1px borders; Berkeley Mono accents. Easings (0.32,0.72,0,1) and (0.16,1,0.3,1).
